tasks.gr6-processing-food-t1: Topic: Methods for processing food. Cover why food is processed (to make it edible, to make it last longer, to improve its nutrients), combining, cooking, freezing, drying, salting, pickling and fermenting, indigenous ways such as biltong, maas (amasi) and mageu, and that processing can lose some nutrients. Ask Grade 6 learners to match a method to its purpose and an example.
